Pet comfort explained just now
This article covers the basics for customers
Traveling with pets through Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare pets for a smooth trip through the skyport. Our handlers use calm, humane methods and keep guidance practical for each step of the journey. Before departure, confirm that your carrier is secure, well ventilated, and sized for your animal to rest comfortably. Bring any required documents, and keep food, water, and comfort items organized so screening goes quickly.

At check-in, staff will review the pet details and direct you to the correct service area. Keep your animal close and speak in a steady voice. If your pet seems uneasy, pause, breathe, and let a handler assist before you continue. Clear handling helps reduce stress for both the traveler and the animal.

In some cases, the senior coordinator may need to confirm how a pet will move through a restricted area or where a temporary hold will be placed. <<FACT F028>> Follow the directions you are given and keep your pet calm while the team completes the handoff.

If your journey includes a stop where a pet relief area is available, staff will show you the access point and explain the routine for safe use. <<FACT F013>> Carry waste bags, clean up after your animal, and make sure the area is left ready for the next traveler.

Before boarding, check that leashes, harnesses, and carrier latches are secure. Keep your pet away from open doors and crowded lanes, and follow handler instructions without delay. A calm pace and simple preparation make the trip easier for everyone.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support.
